latest_release.name: v0.22.0
latest_release.body: ## Highlights ### AI Data Rooms Generation We continue to enhance AI functionalities for data rooms, leveraging the AI components already implemented for you. We recently introduced smart, AI-driven data-room structures. ### Slack Notifications Receive instant view notifications for documents and data rooms inside your Slack channel. One click to connect. ### Hierarchical Auto-Index For large data rooms, it's quite annoying to make sure the index numbers are correct and in order. Our auto-index creates a hierarchical index based on the current folders, documents and subfolders order. ### Noteworthy changes - new file types: .tsv, .m4a, .mp3, .keynote - add option to create data room from templates - add customizable welcome message - add option to create new teams - add workflows for event-based routing (preview) - add folder downloads in data room visitor audit logs - add publishable Q&A - add compliance text option to agreement - add checkbox type to custom form fields - add option to hide data room banner - add invoices page - add search to data rooms overview - improve data room bulk downloads - improve domain configuration - improve global branding ## What's Changed * fix: conversion scaling for long documents by @mfts in
